_comment: SEARCH COMPLETENESS for a CAST TRIGGER's draw: the card Niv-Mizzet, Parun's 'whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, you draw a card' draws must be castable the same turn. Mid-turn frame (resume_at main1, land drop spent): a summoning-sick Parun, Island + Mountain, hand Ponder, Lightning Bolt on top; opponent at 5. Casting Ponder triggers Parun -- it draws the Bolt and pings (4) -- then Ponder draws and pings (3), and the Bolt Parun drew is cast off the Mountain (0). Fails if a cast trigger's draw stops reaching the post-cast re-solve.
